headline: NEW, SUPERSEDES 0800-01 -- Overnight Ukrainian drone wave on Moscow
dek: [PRIMARY-SOURCE CLAIM] Russia downed most of 613 drones heading towards Moscow overnight, Mayor Sergei Sobyanin said on Telegram on Thursday, per Reuters (crawled 08:26 ). In Ukraine, Russia attacked Kharkiv, damaging an educational institution, Mayor Ihor Terekhov said on Telegram, per…
sources: Moscow Mayor Sergei Sobyanin via Telegram, reported by Reuters; Kharkiv Mayor Ihor Terekhov via Telegram, reported by Reuters; ANI morning subset via LatestLY/Tribune
fault_line: Deep strikes on the capital: legitimate pressure that forces talks, or escalation that hardens Moscow?

sections.what_happened: [PRIMARY-SOURCE CLAIM] Russia downed most of 613 drones heading towards Moscow overnight, Mayor Sergei Sobyanin said on Telegram on Thursday, per Reuters (crawled 08:26 ). In Ukraine, Russia attacked Kharkiv, damaging an educational institution, Mayor Ihor Terekhov said on Telegram, per Reuters. This SUPERSEDES 0800-01's rising 166-interception figure: the 613 figure is the overnight total as claimed by Sobyanin, not a second wave. DISCREPANCY FLAGGED, NOT MERGED: ANI's morning piece (09:30 IST = 08:00 ) reports Sobyanin figures of about 30 UAVs approaching the city plus a further 10 after a group of 15 destroyed, with flight restrictions at Vnukovo, Domodedovo and Zhukovsky (lifted at Zhukovsky). The retrieved material does not reconcile the ANI subset (~30-55) with the 613 overnight total -- treat ANI as a partial/morning subset or a sequential update, never add the two together. No casualty or damage figure for Moscow is given in the retrieved Reuters snippet; no Ukrainian confirmation of the wave's size was retrieved this hour. The prior scan's 210-drone Ukraine claim (0800-05, HELD) is a different night's claim and is NOT merged here.
sections.what_verified: 2 declared families for the Moscow claim: Reuters T1 + ANI T1, both resting on Sobyanin's Telegram statements -- so the count is a mayoral claim carried by two wires, not independently verified. Kharkiv damage rests on Reuters T1 alone (Terekhov).
sections.what_disputed: ANI's subset numbers do not reconcile with the 613 total in retrieved material; no independent (non-Russian-official) count of the wave retrieved; no Ukrainian statement on this wave's size retrieved. Sobyanin is an interested party (Moscow mayor) for a claim about Moscow's defence.
sections.why_matters: 613 drones at Moscow in one night -- the number Moscow's own mayor claims. The capital's air war, counted by the city under attack.
sections.context: Background: NEW, SUPERSEDES 0800-01 -- Overnight Ukrainian drone wave on Moscow: Sobyanin claims 613 drones headed for Moscow, most downed; Russia strikes Kharkiv educational institution

totw_analysis: Our read: 613 drones at Moscow in one night -- the number Moscow's own mayor claims. The capital's air war, counted by the city under attack. The fault line our audience is arguing over: Deep strikes on the capital: legitimate pressure that forces talks, or escalation that hardens Moscow?
